headline.preserves: full, at its role's size from the tokens

label.preserves: full: the eyebrow (mono, capitals, letter-spaced, accent)

statement.preserves: full; marks strong/em/accent/muted keep their meaning
statement.degrades: the code mark renders as strong (the page allows no font on a span)

quote.preserves: full in a statement template's stack: text at quote role, attribution and ref on one mono line
quote.degrades: outside that stack (a content kicker or body, a closing stack, a card) the text renders at body role in italics, so it fits the region

number.preserves: full: hero at number role, inline at number_inline, caption beneath
number.degrades: a ghost tone renders in the accent colour like accent (a line of text cannot be dashed)

list.preserves: full: one level, ordered or not

table.preserves: full up to 4 columns at caption role; shares become column widths; rows banded on the card colour
table.degrades: cell runs flatten to plain text (the subset's cells hold plain text: no strong, em, accent or muted inside a cell)

code.preserves: full: one mono card, lines joined by breaks, marked lines in their tone
code.degrades: runs of spaces collapse to one (white-space normal); column alignment is lost; a ghost-marked line renders muted italic (text cannot be dashed)

bars.preserves: full: one shared scale, tracks proportional to value/max, tones kept

diagram.preserves: full: lanes as bands with eyebrow titles, nodes as painted paragraphs, edges as x-connectors from box edge midpoints, buses as drop + bar + stubs (the Rows recipe, mirrored when the children sit beside the parent), paths as one svg with aria_label and no text, labels as paragraphs; ghost = dashed accent on tint
diagram.degrades: a label's for is not rendered (the page pins by coordinates); a straight edge whose endpoints do not align draws as the diagonal the scene asked for; aria_label rides the paths' svg, so a diagram with no paths has no svg on the page and its aria_label is dropped

timeline.preserves: full: one card per beat, eyebrow `at`, ghost beats dashed

comparison.preserves: full: two cards; verdict side takes the accent border

group.preserves: full: row = equal flex cards, column = stack, grid = repeat(N,1fr)

receipt.preserves: full: the footer band, one mono row at bottom 64

note.preserves: full: the slide's speaker notes (aside, last child)
note.drops: cues (the page has no per-atom notes)

deck.sections: full: data-section on each section's start slide
deck.transition: fade and push full; magic only where ids match on both slides (this renderer emits no element ids, so magic degrades to fade)
deck.duration_s: dropped: the page has no clock
deck.title: dropped: a slide's title is viewer metadata (deck.json v4 has no per-slide title and the page shows no HUD)
